title: ContainerEnvironment
description: The project environment contained jobs run in, and the build that made it (ADR 0066).

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

generation.description: The copy in use: `envs/<generation>/` beside this file, named for the attempt that built it; `legacy` is `env/`, an environment from before environment builds.

lock_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the checkout's `uv.lock` the environment was built from. Jobs that run in the environment are refused while the checkout's differs.

built_at.title: Timestamp
built_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

adopted.description: Not built by an environment build: an environment agents installed before ADR 0066, taken as built from the `uv.lock` of the time.
